## Piratecore

Ruffled white poplin under a black lace corset, grounded with a leather-look mini
and chocolate knee-high boots. Stormy, and more wearable than it sounds.

## Grown-up glitter

A radiant, second-skin base plus a grippy shimmer primer and champagne liquid
sparkle, finished with a clean tubing mascara for polished, low-mess shine.

## Opulent decadence

Candlelit skin with a champagne-pearl glow, blush draped high and bold, a crisp
graphic eye and a plush glossy lip.
